# tools: add difftastic

Add [difftastic](https://github.com/wilfred/difftastic), the structural (syntax-aware) diff tool, to the Homebrew toolset. **Motivation:** "research alternative for diff" — compare it with `delta` ([[DOT-183]]), which highlights but diffs line by line.
